name: motion-card-flip
title: Card Flip
description: Thẻ xoay 180° quanh trục dọc, đổi từ mặt trước sang mặt sau ở giữa chừng.

moworks.author: moworks

options.returnAt: s after the start to flip back (null)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Card rotates rotationY 0 → 180° in 760 ms power2.inOut (easeInOutCubic), hinge at the centre; small DOM demo: 58×42 px card, perspective 200 px in its transform, front 'F' in the accent, back 'B' in a darker accent (65 % mix). At 90° (380 ms) the front hides and the back shows — port as fold to 90°, swap, unfold from −90° (backface-visibility is unreliable in renders); the back reads unmirrored. Params: duration, axis x | y, perspective, turns. Params: duration (0.76 s) · axis: trục (y) · perspective (200 px) · turns: số nửa vòng (1). Folds to 90°, swaps the faces and unfolds from −90°, so the back reads unmirrored without backface-visibility.
